name: Shared trip model + event log
description: One source of truth so every stage reads the same people/costs/decisions

name: Headcount recalculation on dropout
description: Withdrawal recomputes per-person cost and threshold viability and applies the agreed rule

name: Private budget ceilings
description: Each friend states a max privately; organiser sees only how many budgets the forecast fits

name: Date options linked to attendance
description: Date poll shows how many can come for each option and feeds the chosen dates downstream

name: Booking register with manual confirmation
description: Stay link-out plus explicit booking reference and cancel-by date; never auto-confirmed

name: Advance shares in one ledger
description: Advance becomes a ledger expense; share requests and payments settle against it

name: Itinerary with conflict and date-change flags
description: Day plan flags overlapping slots and items pushed outside the trip when dates change

name: Expenses with uneven splits and settlement
description: Log who paid and who joined; minimal transfers to settle; mark paid manually

name: Live per-person cost forecast
description: Planned + actual cost per person updates as stay cost and headcount change

name: Today briefing on the trip
description: Today's slots with map links and who is going

name: Calendar add (connector + link fallback)
description: Google Calendar via viewer connector; template link otherwise

name: Maps links per stop
description: Google Maps URLs (documented; no key)

name: Paste booking confirmation parser
description: Claude extracts reference/amount/cancel-by from pasted text; user confirms

name: Weather plan B
description: Needs a server proxy (CSP) and commercial weather licence

name: Live multi-user sync
description: Friends commit from their own phones; needs signed-in viewers

name: Room and bed allocation
description: Fair room assignment for villas

name: Album link + post-trip pulse + reuse as template
description: Close the loop and seed the next trip

name: Multi-origin transport coordinator
description: Group-level route optimisation from several cities

name: Real UPI collection or escrow
description: Regulated; needs PA partner

name: Group dining vote
description: Fast restaurant vote on the trip
